programmes.d: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.
Capt. Danny Allen shares his adventures and tips while he visits Florida's historical fishing destinations.
Capt. Jonathan Moss is in Cape Coral, Florida with perfect conditions to chase a variety of inshore species!
Capt. Mike Anderson and Capt. Ryan Rickard keep track of the catch during a day in Steinhatchee, Fla.
Capt. Jason Dozier and his buddy, Cody Williams head out of Key West to fish for pelagic and dive for Spiny lobster.
Kyle and Jeff head out onto the open ocean to fish for the giant bluefin tuna.
Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.

Capt. Jared travels to Venice, Louisiana, where the Mississippi River meets the Gulf, joining Capt. Garrett George and Capt. Jesse LeBoeuf for an action-packed offshore adventure in pursuit of Redfish and Tuna.
Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger fish out of Key West for tuna and sailfish while battling big sharks and even bigger seas.
Captains Scott and Steve start the season offshore at Plantation Boat Mart with Capt. Scott Stoky by chasing Islamorada tuna and mahi.
Captains Scott and Steve catch a mixed bag while bottom fishing off of Islamorada with Capt. Scott Stoky.
Captains Scott and Steve go yellowtailing out of Hawks Cay for some tasty yellowtail snapper; Steve picks a battle with a big lemon shark.
Captains Scott and Steve bounce around the reefs of Hawks Cay, catching a wide variety of reef dwellers.
Captains Scott and Steve take their brand new 36' Invincible out of Plantation Boat Mart to fly the kites for some early-season sailfish.
When a perons is hot, is hot; Ben McDonald goes on a three or four day run of bow hunting during the rut in the Midwest.
Tom Miranda travels to Namibia to bow hunt the rare black-faced impala.

Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground with flocks of pigeons.
Meredith learns the value of the Trash Can Slam on a flounder trip with Capt. Justin that turns into a multi-species challenge.

Capt. Justin Leake and Meredith McCord divert attention from what's not happening with the tarpon bite to using CoastMaster, light tackle and experience to find snapper success on heavily fished public spots.
Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.
Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.
Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting.

The Missouri River Breaks of Montana is an amazing place to hunt elk; Nate and Clayton both draw tags and can't wait to get to Flatwillow Creek Outfitters for what will be Clayton's first elk hunt in almost 20 years.
Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

For veteran hunter Adam Hays, last season was unlike any other. After years of pursuing trophy whitetails, he accomplished what most hunters only dream of - taking down two record-book Boone & Crockett giants in a single season.
Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.
Rochelle Partridge hunts an ancient buck with her Excalibur crossbow.
After several years of shifting focus back to his native whitetails, Dahlke returns to mule deer country with the Muley Freak, Erik Van Woerkom.

South Dakota public land produces an action-packed hunt as Greg from The Hunting Public hits the ground looking for a mature whitetail! With the rut heating up and bucks ready to fight, Greg gets aggressive with the grunt call.
Join Austin as he heads to Illinois for the first gun season.
Join Gavin as he heads to Virginia to chase gobblers with a long time friend of The Bearded Buck, Ron Kendra.

In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

The Atlanta Braves' Austin Riley will spend September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs; since he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January.
Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.
Tyler Jordan hunts with Perry Ross of Ross Trophy Outfitters.
WWE's Mark Calaway, aka "Undertaker," joins Realtree's David Blanton for a sandhill crane hunt in Texas. The crew put the Franchi Shotguns to work and harvested the "Ribeye of the Sky."
Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.

Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target.

Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.
Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.
Randy and his brother Cody are at the Dirty Bird ranch in Oklahoma doing some summer time maintenance and trying their best to control the hog population by doing a little hog hunting.
The Cast aims to reveal various angling experiences tied to a deeper meaning through the lens of personal experiences; from fresh water in the Midwest, to exploring the saltwater of the coasts.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor continue to fish Florida Bay out of Hawks Cay, catching an incredible variety of flats species including tarpon, snook, redfish, trout and bonefish.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head down to Key West to sample different fishing opportunities in the Marquesas Keys with Captain Bryson Shaaber.

Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor meet up with Captain Nick LaBadie at Big Pine Key for an action-packed day. They're out on the flats chasing tarpon, bonefish, and permit for the elusive Grand Slam.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor run from Hawks Cay Resort to Islamorada on a windy day to fish under the mangroves for Goliath grouper.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor join Captain Bryson Shaaber to fish the channels around Key West, targeting big spring tarpon with live pinfish bait.
Mike fishes in Captiva Fl with local legend Ozzie Fischer. When you're with Ozzie… everyone wins!
Ice fishing crappies at night with Freedom Baitz Bonita Minnow.

Danny Pruitt travels around the country fishing in some of the nation's best kept secrets all while discovering the communities, culture, food, and the people that make each episode unique and entertaining.
Anglers showcase different fishing techniques, share valuable tips, and uncover hidden hotspots.

Capt. Jared travels to Venice, Louisiana, where the Mississippi River meets the Gulf, joining Capt. Garrett George and Capt. Jesse LeBoeuf for an action-packed offshore adventure in pursuit of Redfish and Tuna.
Captain Jared Raskob and guest Captain Jimmy Hendricks face challenges from sharks during a fishing trip; the pair adapts their techniques to successfully catch their target species.
